d95.7b.S5.page.pete.text: Pete Haldane, at the Round Lake counter. His grandpa's plane went through the Kek ice in December 1950. Red and cream, on skis. A map case left in it.

d95.7b.S5.page.south.text: Pete dives the south shore, near the portage. That's where his grandpa said it was.

d95.7b.S5.page.walt.text: Walt saw red and cream in twelve feet off the north shore. A calm day, the water like glass.

d95.7b.S5.page.seen.text: Off the Kek's north shore, in twelve feet: a wing, red and cream, riveted. The cabin door hanging open.

d95.7b.S5.page.case.text: Behind the seat, a leather map case, swollen stiff. A chart inside, in an oilcloth sleeve. Dry.

d95.7b.S5.end.given.text: The chart's on the wall at Round Lake. The case is Pete's.

d95.7b.S5.end.kept.text: The case is mine. Pete has a picture of the chart for his mother.

d95.7b.S5.end.keptno.text: The case is mine. Pete didn't get his picture.

d95.7b.S5.end.told.text: Pete found it, off the north shore. The chart's on the wall at Round Lake, with a card.

d95.7b.S5.pay.told.text: Pete Haldane: for the north shore

d95.7b.S5.cold.text: Cold down there. Colder than on top.

d95.7b.S5.card.text: Found with help from a canoeist

d95.7b.S6.page.orrin.text: Orrin Gilbertson, in cabin four at Aili's motel. Collects Prohibition. Ten summers looking for the pit.

d95.7b.S6.page.route.text: His road: over Lac La Croix and the Beatty, Loon Lake, up the Sioux past where the road crosses, a little lake off the east side with a beaver pond at the back. Bootleg.

d95.7b.S6.page.walt.text: Walt found a tin of bottles in the rocks at Bootleg's beaver pond, and left it.

d95.7b.S6.page.carving.text: At the low end of the Beatty, cut in the rock by the water: N.N. 1928.

d95.7b.S6.page.blazes.text: Old axe blazes from Bootleg's quiet shore, straight inland past the pond. No paint on them.

d95.7b.S6.page.pit.text: Above the pond: a pit under moss, rotten planks laid over it. A tin-lined crate, broken glass, three bottles. A pocket book in oilcloth.

d95.7b.S6.end.sold.text: Sold the book to Orrin. Two-fifty, cash.

d95.7b.S6.end.society.text: The book's under glass with a card.

d95.7b.S6.end.kept.text: The book's still in mine. Orrin went home for the winter.

d95.7b.S6.c.bottle.text: There's a bottle too. The seal's on.

d95.7b.S6.c.society.text: Give it to the historical society.

d95.7b.S6.pay.bottle.text: Orrin Gilbertson: a bottle, seal on

d95.7b.S6.know.text: Moss over something square. Somebody dug here.
